svg.text: Cut 240 wide x 410 tall from 3 mm aluminium; round the corners 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a vertical centre line and a horizontal line across the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp holes: two pairs of 9 mm holes, 42 mm apart across the centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line, 175 mm above and 175 mm below the middle line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug holes: four 5.5 mm holes, 95 mm each side of the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 155 mm above and below the middle line. Check them against the lugs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plate sits on two V-saddles on the outer face of the mast,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by two U-bolts; the box back sits flat on its front face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: offer the box with its lugs fitted; all four holes line up.
